Captain context for t6 (Task 8 acceptance probes) — carried from impl-build's t5 observations, to be active in your verification context when the task unlocks:

1. The vector index you will probe against is FALLBACK-ONLY (no wiki text; text_source=fallback for all rows — tag name + category, short passages). Consequence: e5 similarity distribution on short texts skews high, so the 0.55 default threshold may be loose (impl-build observed gibberish 'zzzzzzzzq' returning 20 hits ≥0.55 on the 200-tag sample). During probes: if precision looks poor (irrelevant tags in top-10), recalibrate the threshold via PM_SEMANTIC_THRESHOLD env for the probe run and record the value + rationale in spec §6 — do NOT edit the code default.
2. Probe targets are head tags (usage-ordered build), so serafuku/twintails/rabbit-ears families will be in the index even in a partial build.
3. The probe index lives at the resolver default path (assets/knowledge/anima-prompt-v1/tag-vector.sqlite); it must be the full 1,374,902-row build (impl-build verifies at t5 close) — confirm the artifact before probing.
4. Standing constraints from the spec/ledger: record every probe's actual top hit + score verbatim; failures recorded honestly with cause analysis; wiki-missing failures go to spec §6/§8 as known limitations (wiki restoration options will be surfaced to the human separately).

UPDATED context for t6 (acceptance probes) — supersedes the earlier fallback-only note; your task is now UNLOCKED (t8+t5 both closed):

1. The live index is now the FINAL wiki-enriched build (587.7MB, payload 1,374,902: wiki 198,738 / fallback 1,176,164). Wiki passages are active for ~198.7k head tags — the Chinese cross-lingual probe (水手服→serafuku) now has real ammunition.
2. KNOWN FINDING to observe (T12-001/T5 finding): search('serafuku') currently returns degenerate tag 'serafuku,' as top-1 (0.8997) with canonical serafuku outside top-10 — e5-small cosine squeeze on short near-duplicate passages. During probes: record whether this reproduces on the probe set; the disposition options are (a) Node-side usage_count rerank of semantic hits, (b) threshold recalibration, (c) passage composition v2 — probe data decides, do not implement.
3. Threshold: default 0.55 stands; recalibrate via PM_SEMANTIC_THRESHOLD env during probes if precision is poor, and record the value + rationale in spec §6. Do NOT edit code defaults.
4. Verify artifact identity before probing: payload 1,374,902 rows, mtime 20:27, wiki/fallback split as above (protects against probing a stale index).
5. Probes remain the plan's four: 水手服 / selafuku / twintail / 兔耳朵 — record actual top hits + scores verbatim in spec §6; failures recorded honestly with cause analysis; scope = spec doc only (no src changes).

Reviewer's t12 also noted: your t13 review will adjudicate the disposition options using your probe data — make the data conclusive (include top-10 lists for each probe).
